In this case, we have to use the identity

$$
1+{cot}^{2}⁡x={csc}^{2}⁡x\,⟹\,{csc}^{2}⁡x-{cot}^{2}⁡x=1.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{\sqrt{e-1}}\frac{x}{{csc}^{2}⁡x+{x}^{2}-{cot}^{2}⁡x}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{1}^{\sqrt{e-1}}\frac{x}{({csc}^{2}⁡x-{cot}^{2}⁡x)+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\sqrt{e-1}}\frac{x}{1+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+{x}^{2})\,{|}_{1}^{\sqrt{e-1}} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+(\sqrt{e-1})^{2})-\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+(1)^{2}) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+e-1)-\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(1+1) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(e)-\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(2) \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(1)-\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{2} \\  & =\frac{1-\operatorname{ln}⁡2}{2}\end{aligned}
$$
